polarization.E: Im h; in coordinates (x_j,y_j), sum_j d_j (x_j yprime_j - y_j xprime_j)
polarization.existence_basepoint: J0 acts by +i on the first 3 complex coordinates and -i on the last 3. E(v,J0v)=sum |d_j| |v_j|^2 > 0.
polarization.warning: J0 is a decomposable existence control, NOT the frontier test fiber.

family.domain: connected component of {J: J^2=-1, JI=IJ, E(Jx,Jy)=E(x,y), E(x,Jx)>0}; U(3,3)/(U(3)xU(3))
family.level: Gamma(3)={g in GL_6(Z[i]): conjugate(g)^t H g=H, g=1 mod 3}
family.abelian_varieties: A_J=(R^12,J)/Z^12 with the integral Riemann form E
family.chosen_scope: very general J in this exact domain, outside proper rational Hodge/endomorphism loci; no numerical sample is substituted
family.generic_NS_authority: Markman arXiv:2509.23403v2, section 1.1, equation (1.1); also 2502.03415v2 section 1.1

discriminant.separation_certificate: For a,b in Q, v_3(a^2+b^2) is even when a^2+b^2 is nonzero. v_3(3)=1.
discriminant.dual_form_det: -1/3; ratio to -3 is 1/9=N(1/3), so the class agrees.

carrier.W: Q r + Q s, equivalently the rational descent of det V_i + det V_-i
carrier.proof: Each of V_i,V_-i has three (1,0) and three (0,1) directions. Their determinant lines have bidegree (3,3). Complex conjugation exchanges them.
carrier.divisor_exclusion: At a very general point NS_Q=Q theta. The Lie derivation D of I^* annihilates theta^3 and has D^2=-36 on W. Thus W intersects Q theta^3 only at zero.

frontier_status_strength: Relative to the primary-source ledger verified today, not a proof that no unindexed theorem exists. No algebraicity counterexample is asserted.
